leads.name: Cat Island Bald Cypress (reader's tip)
leads.reason: Reader's source: americanpress.com 2022-11-20, a 1,500-year-old bald cypress in Cat Island National Wildlife Refuge; reader's girth 1650 cm. US, so FIRST_COUNTRY. Check refuge access (seasonal flooding). Needs two sources (or a register plus a life check) and a pin resolved from the reader's map link before it ships as a reader-found tree; nothing found against it.
